title: Mugs & Keep Cups Workshop at Peninsula Ceramics Studio
summary: Craft a unique set of mugs and/or keep cups in a warm, relaxed studio environment at Moorooduc. Pieces glazed in speckle glaze and ready for pickup in approximately four weeks.
venueName: The Studio and Co, Peninsula Ceramics Studio
priceRange: See booking page for current pricing
suitableFor: Adults, creative enthusiasts, date outings, small groups
accessibilityNotes: Studio setting; contact venue for access requirements
nearbyAttractions: Mornington town centre; Mornington Racecourse markets
suggestedItineraryPairing: Morning workshop at Peninsula Ceramics, then lunch on Mornington Main Street or at Moorooduc Estate
editorVerdict: Make something with your hands for two hours on a rainy July Saturday and pick it up a month later when you've forgotten you made it. Ideal winter activity.
editorNote:
Peninsula Ceramics Studio is running mugs and keep cups workshops through the winter. You make the pieces in a session, they glaze and fire them, and you pick up finished ceramics about four weeks later.

Ends July 26 so the window is closing. Good for a rainy day when you want something to do with your hands rather than your eyes. Warm studio, creative output, and a tangible result to take home.

Adults only - the clay and glazing process needs fine motor control that younger kids don't have. Pair with Mornington Main Street for lunch after the session.
